description: This file defines the LimitStream class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, implementing a stream decorator that limits the number of bytes read from an underlying stream. It provides methods to manage and access a subset of stream data.

classes.name: LimitStream
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps a stream to restrict the amount of data read from it, supporting offset and limit parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a LimitStream instance with a wrapped stream, specifying limit and offset parameters.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached end-of-file based on the limit and underlying stream EOF status.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the limited subset of data available from the stream, considering the limit and the underlying stream size.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream, respecting limit boundaries.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the limited view of the stream.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the starting point for the data limit within the stream, seeking if possible or reading to reach the offset.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes that can be read from the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream respecting the limit and current position, returning an empty string if the limit is reached.
